verdict.rationale: Honcho documents several scoping features that bear on shared versus private memory. Retrieval can be shaped by peer scoping, multi-peer perspective models what one peer knows about another, it keeps state about groups as well as users and agents, and named-scope API keys bind access to a single scope. Workspaces isolate applications, but no workflow is documented for sharing selected memory with a team or group while keeping each member's private memory hidden. missing for 10: explicit shared/group memory semantics, documented per-peer privacy or visibility controls for selective sharing, examples of a team-memory setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share selected memory across multiple agents or users (team or group memory) while keeping private memory private
